messages:
alana: Hi team — planning a short parental leave and a 4-week bridge period at 40% FTE to transition care. Start leave 2026-12-01, return at 40% from 2027-01-15 for 4 weeks. Questions: does the childcare subsidy cover travel costs if I need to bring a caregiver over for 2 weeks? Also need guidance on payroll code, equipment for home, and coverage for my release days.
people-ops: Congrats @alana! :tada: Short answers: 1) subsidy may cover limited travel for licensed caregivers with prior approval; upload provider/license and travel justification on the phased-return form. 2) use code PT40-2027 so payroll ties proration. 3) equipment OK — add address. 4) we can flag you on the rota so alerts escalate after your shift.
michelle: Payroll note: PT40-2027 will prorate premiums and subsidy. Travel reimbursements are processed as taxable reimbursements — submit receipts with code TRV-CARE. If you want an estimate for net pay during 40% please DM me.
diego: I can cover release days for the first two weeks of your ramp and pair with recruiting for weeks 3-4 if you want a short-term contractor. What days are you planning to be online?\galana: Tue/Thu remote, Wed in-office. Off Mon/Fri for care handoffs. (typo in previous msg: that's me @alana).
recruiting: We can open a 0.2 FTE contractor req focused on PR reviews and release notes. ETA to shortlist ~10 business days. Tagging people-ops for onboarding checklist.
people-ops: Routing snippet to paste in rota: ```if user.fte <= 0.5 then escalate_after(21:00) // show reduced-hours badge``` We'll add a visual flag.
alana: Do I need new FMLA or adoption docs for the bridge period? I filed leave already. Want to avoid delays.
people-ops: No new FMLA if leave is continuous and the bridge is within the approved return window. If travel or caregiver arrangement changes the certified support, we may request an update.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit the phased-return form within 7 business days to guarantee equipment shipping before your start date. Include provider docs for travel reimbursement requests.
michelle: Also: overnight caregiver travel approvals take longer — expect 5 business days for compliance signoff. If approved, payroll will process TRV-CARE reimbursements on the next payroll cycle after receipts.
diego: I'll draft the coverage rota and include pairing sessions. Alana, ping me when the form is in so I can finalize schedule.
alana: Submitted the form, uploaded caregiver license + travel note, and included PT40-2027. Thanks everyone :heart:
